dashboard.name: Country Context
dashboard.description: The macro backdrop the programme operates against: World Bank indicators and UNHCR displacement figures.

cards.name: GDP growth by country
cards.description: Annual GDP growth, the indicator the programme's own results should be read against.
cards.sql:
select year, country_name, value as gdp_growth_pct
from mart_country_indicators
where indicator_code = 'NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG'
order by year

cards.name: Displaced population hosted
cards.description: Refugees, asylum seekers, IDPs and others of concern, per UNHCR.
cards.sql:
select year, country_name, total_displaced_hosted
from mart_country_refugee_stats
order by year

cards.name: Displaced population hosted, latest year
cards.description: Mapped on ISO-2 codes so the built-in world map matches.
cards.sql:
select c.iso2_code as country, r.total_displaced_hosted as displaced
from mart_country_refugee_stats r
inner join stg_countries c on r.country_iso3 = c.iso3_code
where r.year = (select max(year) from mart_country_refugee_stats)
order by displaced desc

cards.name: Biggest year-on-year indicator moves
cards.description: Where the macro picture shifted most, in either direction.
cards.sql:
select country_name, indicator_name, year, round(value, 2) as value,
       round(prior_year_value, 2) as prior_year_value, round(yoy_change, 2) as yoy_change
from mart_indicator_yoy_growth
where prior_year_value is not null
order by abs(yoy_change) desc
limit 25
